responses: Hello 👋 I am your University Admission Assistant. Ask me about courses, fees, admissions or timings.
Goodbye 👋 Best of luck with your studies!
We offer BSCS, BBA, Electrical Engineering, Software Engineering, and Artificial Intelligence.
BSCS: 4 years | Fee: 55k–80k | Classes: 9AM–2PM | Focus: Programming, AI, Databases
BBA: 4 years | Fee: 50k–70k | Classes: 8:30AM–1:30PM | Focus: Marketing, Finance, HRM
AI: 4 years | Fee: 70k–120k | Classes: 10AM–3PM | Focus: ML, DL, Data Science
Software Engineering: 4 years | Fee: 60k–100k | Focus: Development, Testing, DevOps
Fees vary by program: BSCS 55–80k, BBA 50–70k, AI 70–120k, SE 60–100k per semester.
Apply online from June to August. Submit documents and appear in entry test.
Admission deadline is 31st August every year.
Entry test includes English, Math, and IQ-based MCQs.
You need FA/FSc or equivalent with minimum 50% marks + CNIC/Form-B + photos.
We offer merit-based and need-based scholarships.
Yes, separate hostels for boys and girls with WiFi and mess facility.
Morning: 8:30AM–2:30PM | Evening: 3PM–7PM depending on department.
The university is located in the main city campus with easy transport access.
Contact admission office via phone or email listed on official website.
Library is open 8AM–8PM with digital + physical books.
University provides transport service for main city routes.
Midterms and finals are held every semester according to academic calendar.
Results are announced online through student portal.
We offer computer labs, science labs, sports ground, cafeteria, and WiFi campus.
Cafeteria offers affordable meals and snacks for students.
Minimum 75% attendance is required for exams eligibility.
Students must follow university discipline rules and maintain proper conduct.
We provide internship opportunities in final year with partner companies.
Final year students are assigned supervisors for project guidance.
